message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO" in large red letters across the top. Below the title, the word "INVESTIGASI" is set within a black rectangle with a red "T" symbol. The main headline reads "PELOBI ASING DI DEKAT PRESIDEN" in bold black capital letters. Smaller text below mentions "Dua warga asing" and "Presiden Prabowo," with a reference to "H.24." Other text at the top reads "Mengapa Gunawan Jusuf Dibidik H.76" and "Biang Kenaikan Harga Pangan H.84."

The central image is a stylized cartoon showing three figures sitting on a long wooden bench against a backdrop of dense, green tropical foliage. In the middle is a short, round man with a tan complexion, a black songkok hat, and a light-tan uniform. To his left sits a woman with long blonde hair, wearing a white belted outfit. To his right sits a larger man with light hair, a blue-tinged beard, and a similar tan uniform with dark boots. All three figures have small, simplified facial features. The bottom-left corner contains a barcode, a QR code, and publication details: "23 FEBRUARI - 1 MARET 2024," "RP 60.000," and "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN."
